title.zh-CN: LSRGET 活动 BARG 视图

summary.en: This clause maps LSRGET IDs 0, 1, and 2 to BPC, the Standard/Floating-block BPCN, and the packed BARG control word. Reserved IDs and an inapplicable ID 1 are rejected before any destination effect.
summary.zh-CN: 本条目说明 LSRGET 的 ID 0、1、2 分别读取 BPC、Standard/Floating Block 的 BPCN 和打包后的 BARG 控制字；保留 ID 或不适用的 ID 1 会在产生目标写入前被拒绝。

summary.en: This clause anchors the accepted decisions for OR to its mnemonic-local assembly, encoding legality, defaults, effects, ordering, fault boundaries, and executable operation region.

summary.en: This clause treats PRF as modified-and-shifted address formation for a non-faulting hint. Every destination encoding is a non-writing alias, so legal execution produces no translation, memory event, ordering edge, or destination effect.
summary.zh-CN: 本条目将 PRF 界定为对寄存器地址进行修饰和移位后形成的非故障提示。所有目标编码都是不写入的别名，因此合法执行不会产生地址转换、内存事件、顺序边或目标写入。

title.zh-CN: PRFI.U 非故障 L1 提示

summary.en: This clause defines PRFI.U as forming one non-faulting L1 hint address from a sign-extended, unscaled 12-bit byte displacement. Every destination encoding is non-writing, with no translation, memory event, ordering edge, or destination effect.
summary.zh-CN: 本条目说明 PRFI.U 将未缩放的 12 位字节位移符号扩展后形成一个非故障 L1 提示地址。所有目标编码均不写入，也不会产生地址转换、内存事件、顺序边或目标影响。

summary.en: This clause gives all register-offset AGU forms a common SrcRType interpretation before the encoded or fixed left shift: 00 leaves the value unchanged, 01 selects .sw, and 10 selects .uw. Encoding 11 is rejected before source reads or effects.
summary.zh-CN: 本条目统一寄存器偏移 AGU 形式在编码或固定左移之前对 SrcRType 的解释：00 保持原值，01 选择 .sw，10 选择 .uw；编码 11 会在读取源操作数或产生架构影响前被拒绝。

title.zh-CN: Scalar Bundle Body 进入边界

summary.en: This clause places the bundle body-entry transition immediately after successful scalar decode and before applicability or operand checks. An unmatched carrier causes no entry, while a later scalar fault leaves the body-active transition visible.
summary.zh-CN: 本条目将 Bundle Body 的进入转换放在 Scalar 形式成功解码之后、适用性或操作数检查之前。未匹配的载体不会进入 Body；解码后发生的 Scalar 故障则保留已进入 Body 的可见状态。

summary.en: This clause records the ADR-defined boundary for SD.U: snapshot address and data sources, apply its width and address-update mode, preflight the access, then commit the store event and any base update at the restart boundary.

summary.en: This clause records the ADR-defined boundary for SD.XOR: preflight the complete atomic access before effects, then commit its selected width, ordering, memory update, event, and result as one atomic outcome.
summary.zh-CN: 本条目记录 SD.XOR 的 ADR 决策边界：在产生任何影响前预检完整原子访问，随后将所选宽度、顺序、内存更新、事件和结果作为一个原子结果提交。

summary.en: This clause confines SETC.AND to an active Conditional block. Only the first successful SETC in that block can snapshot sources and atomically update CommitArgument and BARG.TAKEN; a rejected attempt leaves the shared marker available.

title.zh-CN: SETRET 保留返回状态更新

summary.en: This clause records SETRET's ADR-defined outcome: the pre-increment TPC plus the zero-extended, halfword-scaled immediate updates architectural ra and retained return state atomically, while retirement remains sequential and installs no direct branch target.
summary.zh-CN: 本条目记录 SETRET 的 ADR 决策结果：用递增前的 TPC 加上零扩展且按半字缩放的立即数，原子更新架构 ra 与保留返回状态；指令仍按顺序退休，不直接安装分支目标。

summary.zh-CN: 本条目记录 SRLW 的 ADR 执行边界：先快照 Scalar 源操作数，再应用该助记符负责的位宽、立即数、修饰和回绕规则，最后按别名安全的顺序发布到指定目标或提交影响。

summary.en: This clause places SSRGET's instruction-specific system or maintenance access check before effects. A rejected attempt preserves destination, queue, and system state apart from the ordinary instruction-attempt trap envelope.
summary.zh-CN: 本条目将 SSRGET 特有的系统或维护访问域检查置于所有影响之前。若尝试被拒绝，除普通指令尝试的 Trap 包络外，目标、队列和系统状态均保持不变。

summary.en: This clause records the ADR-defined boundary for SW.ADD: preflight the complete atomic access before effects, then commit its selected width, ordering, memory update, event, and result as one atomic outcome.
summary.zh-CN: 本条目记录 SW.ADD 的 ADR 决策边界：在产生任何影响前预检完整原子访问，随后将所选宽度、顺序、内存更新、事件和结果作为一个原子结果提交。

summary.en: This clause records the ADR-defined boundary for SW: snapshot address and data sources, apply its width and address-update mode, preflight the access, then commit the store event and any base update at the restart boundary.
summary.zh-CN: 本条目记录 SW 的 ADR 决策边界：先快照地址与数据源，再应用该助记符的宽度和地址更新模式，完成访问预检后，在规定的重启边界提交存储事件及可能的基址更新。
